no-nameserver.title: The delegation has no name server
no-nameserver.detail: A delegation without NS record leaves the subdomain unreachable. Add at least one name server, two ideally.

single-nameserver.title: "{{subdomain}}" is delegated to a single name server
single-nameserver.detail: RFC 1034 asks for at least two name servers, on separate machines: with only one, the subdomain disappears whenever that server is down.

invalid-target.title: Invalid name server "{{target}}"
invalid-target.detail: A name server must be given as a valid host name, as defined by RFC 1035.

duplicate-target.title: Duplicate name server "{{target}}"
duplicate-target.detail: The same name server is listed more than once. Keep only one record.

missing-glue.title: "{{target}}" needs a glue record
missing-glue.detail: This name server lives inside "{{subdomain}}", the very zone it serves: resolvers can only find its address here, in the parent zone. Add a Server entry carrying its A/AAAA, or use a name server outside the delegated subdomain.

target-is-cname.title: Name server "{{target}}" is an alias
target-is-cname.detail: RFC 2181 sec. 10.3 requires the target of an NS record to be a host name, never a CNAME.

target-no-address.title: Name server "{{target}}" has no A/AAAA in this zone
target-no-address.detail: Add a Server entry for this name, or check that the name server FQDN is correct.

ds-without-ns.title: A DS record without any name server
ds-without-ns.detail: A DS tells the resolvers the delegated zone is signed. Without the NS records to go with it, the whole subtree fails validation instead of simply disappearing.

ds-invalid-keytag.title: DS key tag "{{keytag}}" is out of range
ds-invalid-keytag.detail: A key tag is a 16-bit unsigned integer (0..65535).

ds-unknown-digest-type.title: Unknown DS digest type "{{digesttype}}"
ds-unknown-digest-type.detail: Only SHA-1 (1), SHA-256 (2) and SHA-384 (4) are defined. Copy the DS record your registrar or your signer gave you.

ds-digest-length.title: The DS digest should be {{expected}} hexadecimal characters long, not {{got}}
ds-digest-length.detail: The digest does not match the declared digest type, so no resolver will be able to validate the delegation. Copy the DS record again from your signer.

ds-sha1.title: This DS uses a SHA-1 digest
ds-sha1.detail: RFC 8624 deprecates SHA-1. Publish a SHA-256 digest instead, and check whether your registry still requires the SHA-1 one.

ds-deprecated-algorithm.title: DS algorithm {{algorithm}} is deprecated
ds-deprecated-algorithm.detail: RFC 8624 advises against this signing algorithm. Roll the key of the delegated zone over to ECDSAP256SHA256 (13) or ED25519 (15).

ds-duplicate.title: Duplicate DS record for key tag {{keytag}}
ds-duplicate.detail: The same digest is published twice. Keep only one record.

Delegation.name: Delegation
Delegation.description: Delegate this subdomain to another name server
